giver: Brian, back room of Brian's Marina, Key Lento
steps: Ride with Brian to Kingfishers Camp in northwest Mariana County
Follow Brian on foot to the pig pen and inspect it
Survive the Kingfishers' ambush and follow Brian's green dot
Take the helicopter on the left side and chase the boat
Shoot the enemies from the helicopter, then jump across to the boat
tips: Back home, tell Lucia about Brian's retirement for a relationship boost
Stay close to the boat's side or the jump won't trigger
Move fast: gunfire can wreck your boat engine
